cells.tense: Present tense — here, with the pen.
cells.verb: You move through what isn't clear yet, without forcing it into shape.
cells.place: Standing in the question with your grip open.
cells.ask: Offer this vision one step of motion — give it somewhere to go, and let the direction rise out of what you actually care about rather than out of effort. When this comes back to level, you dream from what you've lived rather than from what you're bracing against.
cells.core: You can steer by partial light. Enough to see the next step is enough — you're not waiting for the whole road to show up before you move, and the pictures that come to you now come from somewhere real. Nothing is being avoided here. Experience has already been lived through and let go of, and what's left is a vision that can carry weight because it isn't carrying everything.
cells.sheetLine: You trust the next step without needing to see the whole road.

cells.tense: Future tense — bracing at a future that can't be written in.
cells.verb: You keep moving through the haze, but now the pictures have taken over the ground you're standing on.
cells.place: Somewhere ahead of yourself, living inside a story that hasn't happened.
cells.ask: Put your care on something small and actually growing — tend one real thing without steering where it ends up, and let the care be enough for today. When this comes back to level, you'll dream from what you've lived, not from what you're fleeing toward.
cells.core: You've stopped distinguishing what you're imagining from what's in front of you. The depth is real, but it's swallowing the shoreline — every symbol feels like a directive, every sign like a verdict, and you're living in a version of things that hasn't happened yet. Somewhere under all of it is the wish for it to already be settled. But you can't brace your way into an unwritten future; the effort itself is what keeps you from seeing where you actually are.
cells.sheetLine: The dream has become the whole map, and you're lost inside it.

cells.tense: Past tense — still standing at a door that's already behind you.
cells.verb: You move through uncertainty by narrowing it, cutting the symbolic off at the root.
cells.place: At a threshold you crossed long ago, checking it like it might still be locked.
cells.ask: Let one thing you know land without having to justify it — just attend carefully to one person or one thing that matters this week, and let what you notice stand without argument. When this comes back to level, your vision will flow again out of what you've actually lived through.
cells.core: There's nothing wrong with your grip on reality. What's missing is the willingness to let anything be more than it appears. Precision became a wall — depth gets called vague, intuition gets called unreliable, and anything symbolic gets shown the door before it can say anything. The pictures still come, they just don't get to land. And you keep standing at a threshold you already crossed, as if stepping through again might finally make it legitimate.
cells.sheetLine: You've made yourself very sure, and the certainty is a closed door.

cells.tense: Disowned present — pen down in a room you're already writing.
cells.verb: You're moving through the unclear, and the pictures you're forming are already shaping how you live.
cells.place: In a life that's being drawn from a dream you haven't admitted you're having.
cells.ask: Pick one plain practice and keep it — a small steady thing done on purpose — and let the shape of it tell you what you've been reaching for. When this comes back to level, the vision will come from what you've worked through, not from what you've been quietly rehearsing.
cells.core: You already imagine. That part is running. You just talk about your life like the shape of it arrived from outside — circumstances, timing, other people's decisions — while something in you keeps sketching the outlines ahead of time. The dreams are steering and you haven't put your hand up as the one holding the pen. There's nothing missing here but the signature on the page.
cells.sheetLine: You're already dreaming this. You just haven't claimed it.
